preconditions.description: Both strings P and T must have a length of at least 1.
The lengths of strings P and T must not exceed 10,000 characters.

preconditions.expression: all(c in 'abcdefghijklmnopqrstuvwxyz' for c in P) and all(c in 'abcdefghijklmnopqrstuvwxyz' for c in T)
preconditions.description: Both strings P and T must consist only of lowercase English letters.

postconditions.description: The output must be the count of valid selections modulo 10^9 + 7.
The count of valid selections must be a non-negative integer.
